_meta.status: hypothesis — designed to be deformed by the inference store
_meta.description: Sparse coordinate system for social communication at the local scale (individual to nearby society). Abstract enough to apply across fields. Does not describe civilization-level or institutional language — that is where the sanitizing status quo operates. This schema covers the pre-institutional layer where communication is most genuine.
sources: Logos Core Tree — synthesized in project (not from a single author)
_meta.llm: claude-sonnet-4-6 | 2026-05-20 | pillars/logos/logos_schema_v01.json | created seed schema from session synthesis

act_type.description: What kind of action the communication performs. From speech act theory — utterances do things, they are not just descriptions.

values.directive: attempts to get someone to do something
values.commissive: commits the speaker to future action
values.declaration: changes reality by being said (a verdict, a ruling, a dismissal)

transmission.description: How the communication moves through the social field. Describes the channel, not the content.

values.broadcast: one-to-many, public, low fidelity to source
values.leak: restricted, few recipients, high emotional charge, unofficial
values.archive: past-to-future, preserved, institutional, resistant to revision

resonance.description: The emotional field the communication carries or creates in the local social environment.

authority.description: What power structure or trust source the communication draws on to be heard.

values.occult: hidden, not publicly acknowledged, known only within a restricted group

utility.description: What the communication is functionally for — its payload.

values.instruction: actionable, enabling — tells someone how or what to do
values.currency: value-tracking, social capital, ledger of obligation

cooperative.description: Whether Grice's cooperative maxims are honored or violated. Violations generate implicature — meaning beyond the words. The gap between said and meant is a tension signal.

maxims.quality: say what you believe to be true

social_field.description: Douglas grid/group axes describing the social constraint field in which the communication occurs.
social_field.grid: 0.0-1.0: degree to which behavior is constrained by explicit rules (0.0=unconstrained, 1.0=rigid)
social_field.group: 0.0-1.0: degree to which individual identity is defined by group membership (0.0=individual, 1.0=collective)

inference_tag.description: How a specific inference is placed in this coordinate space. All fields null by default — an inference does not need to fill every dimension.

what_this_is_not.note: This schema does not cover the non-verbal, silent, affective layer of communication — the vibe operating below speech that drives local social environments and can move to population-level influence. That layer is the social neurology component, partially developed in pillars/. The tension between what signify captures (explicit) and what social neurology operates (implicit) is where the most significant social signals live.
